svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, two kinds of hand-off. Ask, FIX-1816: a task on the asker's own board, addTask with waitForResponse; the turn parks on it and resumes with its real answer, across a restart, the asked worker running once, bounded by a fixed timeout, depth 1 with no nested asks, and a cancel that reaches the child. Assign stays open, FIX-1817: an answered park resumes the same task session; a finished session answers follow-up questions and takes a follow-up task, through answerTask and addTask's followUpOf. Under both, the Layer 1 seam: a server-side resume, a wait binding, the waitForResponse option on addTask with no new tool, a resume-owed marker, answerTask as a ninth task tool with addTask's followUpOf, and a durable test runtime. Built once elsewhere and lifted or reused here: the child-finished notices from FIX-1794 P2, which ask lifts into orchestration, the settle-owed marker's pattern from FIX-1802, which ask's own marker reuses, and the board's claim ticket or FIX-1791's delivery ledger as the one answer-once check; generator suspend and resume already ships. The app's: which kind to use per call, and the Shift Manager composer, FIX-1764 and FIX-1765. Not built, below a fence: an untrusted external inbox, skill agents in any form, one merged kind, a request held open, parallel fan-in beyond one-at-a-time resume, nested asks, a third answer-once check.

g.text: IN THE BOX — TWO KINDS OF HAND-OFF, BOTH SURVIVE A RESTART, THE WORK RUNS ONCE
ask · FIX-1816
a task on its own board · addTask + waitForResponse
the turn parks on it and resumes with the answer
across a restart · the asked worker runs once
bounded: a fixed timeout · depth 1 · cancel reaches it
assign stays open · FIX-1817
an answered park resumes the same task session
which keeps what it did before it parked
finished: answers follow-up questions
takes a follow-up task (answerTask, followUpOf) · never locks
the Layer 1 seam, D5: server-side resume · a wait binding · waitForResponse on addTask, no new tool
a resume-owed marker · answerTask, a ninth task tool · a durable in-memory runtime for tests
BUILT ONCE ELSEWHERE, LIFTED OR REUSED HERE · D2
the child-finished signal: completed · errored · parked · FIX-1794 P2, lifted by ask
the owed-marker pattern: settle-owed · FIX-1802 · ask's marker reuses it
one answer-once check: the claim ticket, or the delivery ledger
generator suspend and resume, as human approval uses it · ships
THE APP'S
ask or assign, per call · dispatch default
the timeout: fixed, not the app's
the finished-task composer
FIX-1764 · epic FIX-1765
NOT BUILT
no untrusted external inbox: "mailbox" stays reserved · no skill agents: in any form, no private team
no one merged kind · no request held open while it waits · no third answer-once check
no parallel fan-in beyond a correct one-at-a-time resume · no nested asks
